<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" modified="2026-10-03T02:00:00.000Z" agent="Mozilla/5.0" version="24.0.0" type="embed"> <diagram id="telegram-arch" name="Telegram Migration Architecture"> <mxGraphModel dx="1400" dy="900" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1240" pageHeight="940" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<mxCell id="h1" value="<b>Telegram Migration Pipeline — Concurrency &amp; Reliability Architecture</b><br>C4 Component Model • QThread-to-Asyncio Bridge • Native MTProto Batching • SHA-256 Checkpointing • Adaptive Flood Control" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#FFFFFF;align=left;spacingLeft=20;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="30" width="1160" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="pres-layer" value="PRESENTATION TIER: DUAL INTERFACE (DESKTOP GUI &amp; HEADLESS CLI)" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;strokeColor=#94A3B8;fillColor=#F8FAFC;fontColor=#64748B;fontSize=11;startSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="120" width="1160" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="gui" value="<b>PyQt6 Interactive Desktop GUI (main.py)</b><br>Channel queue, live progress, non-blocking 60 FPS UI" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="pres-layer"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="34" width="510" height="66" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cli" value="<b>Rich Headless Terminal CLI (cli.py)</b><br>Automated server daemon, queue processing, UNIX signals" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="pres-layer"> <mxGeometry x="610" y="34" width="510" height="66" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="bridge-layer" value="CONCURRENCY &amp; WORKER BRIDGE: ISOLATED OS THREAD &amp; ASYNCIO EVENT LOOP" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#F5F3FF;fontColor=#6D28D9;fontSize=12;startSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="275" width="1160" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="qthread" value="<b>ForwardWorker (QThread)</b><br>Dedicated thread, private asyncio loop" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="bridge-layer"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="36" width="340" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="signals" value="<b>Thread-Safe Signal Dispatch</b><br>sig_progress, sig_log, sig_finished" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="bridge-layer"> <mxGeometry x="410" y="36" width="340" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="canceller" value="<b>Cancellation &amp; State Flusher</b><br>threading.Event stop flag, flush checkpoint" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="bridge-layer"> <mxGeometry x="790" y="36" width="340" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="engine-layer" value="EXECUTION ENGINE: FAULT-TOLERANT BULK FORWARDER (utils.py)" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;strokeColor=#10B981;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#FFFFFF;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=12;startSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="425" width="820" height="280" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="route-mgr" value="<b>Route Key Manager</b><br>SHA-256 route hash (16-char)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#64748B;fontColor=#1E293B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="engine-layer"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="44" width="245" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flood-ctrl" value="<b>Adaptive Flood Controller</b><br>Jitter delay, FloodWait cooldown" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="engine-layer"> <mxGeometry x="285" y="44" width="250" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tcp-rec" value="<b>TCP Connection Recovery</b><br>Catches WinError 64 &amp; reconnects" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FEF2F2;strokeColor=#EF4444;fontColor=#991B1B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="engine-layer"> <mxGeometry x="555" y="44" width="245" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="batch-mode" value="<b>Native RPC Batching Mode (Fast)</b><br>Up to 100 msgs/call, server-side copy" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="engine-layer"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="158" width="380" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="anon-mode" value="<b>Anonymized Re-Send Mode (Clean)</b><br>In-memory media buffer, strips headers" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="engine-layer"> <mxGeometry x="420" y="158" width="380" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="extractor-layer" value="EXTRACTION ENGINE (link_extractor.py)" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;strokeColor=#6366F1;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#EEF2FF;fontColor=#3730A3;fontSize=12;startSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="880" y="425" width="320" height="280" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="entity-ext" value="<b>Entity &amp; URL Extractor</b><br>MessageEntityTextUrl, t.me handles" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontColor=#1E1B4B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="extractor-layer"> <mxGeometry x="15" y="44" width="290" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="export-ext" value="<b>Multi-Format Exporter</b><br>JSON stream, CSV, Excel XLSX" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontColor=#1E1B4B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="extractor-layer"> <mxGeometry x="15" y="158" width="290" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

g.text: Telegram Migration Pipeline — Concurrency & Reliability Architecture
C4 Component Model • QThread-to-Asyncio Bridge • Native MTProto Batching • SHA-256 Checkpointing • Adaptive Flood Control
PRESENTATION TIER: DUAL INTERFACE (DESKTOP GUI & HEADLESS CLI)
Visual channel queue setup, real-time progress bars, type filters, and live log stream
QMainWindow • Dedicated QThread worker • Non-blocking 60 FPS UI
Automated server daemon, queue file processing (--source-queue), transfer speed telemetry
UNIX signals (SIGINT / SIGTERM) • Rich Progress & Live Tables
CONCURRENCY & WORKER BRIDGE: ISOLATED OS THREAD & ASYNCIO EVENT LOOP
• Forwards up to 100 messages per round-trip
• Server-side media copy on Telegram data center
• In-memory media stream buffer to target channel
PERSISTENCE & FAULT-TOLERANCE LAYER (ATOMIC JSON CHECKPOINTS & ROTATING LOGS)
